notes: SQLite everywhere: the LAN/mobile API moved into its own router (src/main/lanApi.js) and every read endpoint (clients, inventory, transactions, stats, expenses, suppliers, purchase-orders, reports, settings, backups, sqlite-status) now serves straight from the SQLite store - no more renderer round-trip, and the mobile server keeps working even with the window closed. Schema changes are now versioned (schema_migrations) so future releases can ALTER safely, and the database health card shows the schema version. The Backups modal gained Import JSON: old pre-SQLite .json backups (including encrypted ones) can be imported into the live database, replacing all stores with a .prerestore safety copy kept.
